steps.name: Following the flowers (1)
steps.objective: Meet [Adrian] at “Glaston Central Square” and talk to him using (current rumor) in the conversation menu. After the story, report the quest to [Adrian].

lines.text: (A warm wind blows in front of %s, who was looking around Glaston Central Square. Perhaps riding that wind, flower petals from somewhere fall in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did it come from? I love the scent of flowers... .
(Your steps move naturally, as if you are guided by the scent that approaches you. As you walk a few steps, you see a stand selling flowers welcoming customers.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, it came from here.
(A young man sitting behind a street cart stands up as if he feels threatened.)
Oh, hello… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, hello… . I smelled a flower from somewhere and found it here... .
Was the flower scent so strong that it could be felt far away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather than saying it's rich, I should say something. There was a refreshing scent like fruit juice, and there was also a scent that tickled the tip of my nose like a thick perfume... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There was also a scent that reminded me of something I smelled at the beach.
(The expressionless young man is slightly surprised upon hearing %s's story.)
… You matched the scents of the three types of flowers I brought with you today. You are amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? I think it's just because I like all flowers.
(The young man smiles lightly and introduces himself.)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: My name is Adrian. We bring and sell flowers grown directly from the flower garden. But it seems like this is my first time seeing you at the square... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, this is my first time coming to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: If you don't mind, could you tell me your name?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: %s… no see.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: That's a good name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think Adrian heard the rumor about me.)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It doesn't look like you need flowers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. Because of my job, I've been asking people about things... .

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's okay. Please speak.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adrian.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: If it's like a rumor... . well. hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Would this be okay? I heard a story about some kids who came to buy flowers, and they said they heard a strange noise coming from the neighborhood... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Can you tell me in detail?

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Yes… . There is a street in Glaston called Rashuet that is considered a slum.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's a bit dark because it's on lower ground compared to areas like the central square or residential district. That doesn't mean the people there are dark, though.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Anyway… , They say that at night, this sound is heard from inside Rashuet, from the direction of the waterway that is not currently in use.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I want to go out, I want to go out... . Someone is sobbing and making this sound, but if you get closer, you can't hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You want to go out...?)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Some curious children went into the waterway to explore without the adults knowing, but found nothing.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It's so strange... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Aqueduct of slum Rashuet? Hmm….)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Don't take it too seriously. Rumors are often just rumors... .

steps.name: Following the flowers (2)
steps.objective: After talking to [Adrian] in “Glaston Central Square,” use the gathering skill on the flower cart to obtain “Adrian Garden Flowers.” Then, report the quest to [Ethel] in ‘Glaston Central Square’.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Did you find this helpful?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I want to leave, obviously….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adrian, thank you.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Are you working as a detective or solver or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I do do similar things.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I hope it isn't dangerous... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's probably not as bad as Adrian thinks.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: If so, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, by the way, what are these pink flowers here? I can't smell the scent of this flower alone.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It is a flower called Romelia, and it has little scent, so it is often used as an ornamental.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I thought it was strange at first, but when I think about the environment in which the flowers grew, I understand it.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Flowers that bloom in the winter must withstand the cold to meet the warm spring. I think maybe the scent of the flowers disappeared during the harsh winter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: As we pass winter and enter spring, the language of flowers means new encounters.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: I often give these flowers to people I meet for the first time because I want them to have a good memory of me, but it’s okay… Are you there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course it's okay. Thank you, Adrian.
(Adrian smiles brightly when he sees %s happy to receive the flowers. Then, as if he spots someone passing by, he calls out their name with all his might.)

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Ethel! Ethel!

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Ah… , gone. I guess you didn't hear me. When you asked me about the rumor earlier, I thought Ethel might be helpful.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: He is very smart and knows a lot, so he often gives me advice on my concerns. Sometimes, when I look at this child, I feel like he is more adult than me.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: It looks like you're just taking a walk. Would you like to talk to Ethel?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let me go and talk.

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Oh, Ethel loves the flowers from our Adrian Garden. Could you please take some flowers out of the flower cart and give them to Ethel? You don’t have to feel burdened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 아드리안
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. There are plenty of flowers.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Adrian. I'll go and see Ethel. So which flower would be good?

steps.name: Following the flowers (3)
steps.objective: After talking to [Ethel] in 「Glaston Central Square」, obtain <Black Bone> at 「Gate of Lysithea」. Then, report the quest to [Ethel] in ‘Glaston Central Square’.

lines.text: (A little girl who was humming looks around when she hears someone calling her.)
Did I hear it wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Adrian called. It's Ethel, right?
(The girl looks suspiciously when someone she doesn't know says her name.)
Who is asking me questions? Seeing as you brought flowers, do you think you are trying to confess to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Confession? Oh, it's not like that.
It's a joke.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. Let me start by introducing myself. That will clear Ethel's suspicions, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am %s… ,
(Ethel is slightly surprised when Adventurer reveals her name.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Are you by any chance Adventurer? It is said that he recently rescued people stranded on Aie Island... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know me?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Of course I know. There will be very few people in Glaston who don't know %s's name. Except for Uncle Adrian.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . I didn't know.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: As expected, he has no interest in anything other than flowers. %s, will you give me those flowers?
(Ethel takes the flowers from %s and smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Thank you. My name is Ethel.  You know that flower? Edelweiss… . It's that Ethel.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: When Uncle Adrian called me, he means to talk to %s, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How... .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Since I like flowers, you probably told me to bring them for you, right? Hehehe. So, %s, what do you want to talk about with me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, that’s why I said he was a child like an adult.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard any strange rumors in Glaston lately?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Well… . %s, wait a minute… . Can I sit down for a moment?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I felt dizzy for a moment... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ethel, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: If you sit down for a while you'll be fine. I'm a bit weak, so I do this sometimes.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: 10 years ago, I suffered from a fever, and it was said that I died but came back to life. To be honest, I don't remember much, but I got through it well and I'm fine now.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Mendels has improved enough to go for a walk with a 14-year-old.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mendelsmann at age 14? Who is that?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: This is a black dog raised at home, as big as a bear. It's not a real bear, though.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Grandfather's grandfather, grandfather's grandfather... , I continued to raise the dog that my grandfather raised for generations.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Now, we are the 14th generation of Mendels. Mendelsmann seems to be in a bad mood these days.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I don't know where I lost the toy I carried around with me every day, but I went home and wouldn't come out.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: They even bought me a new toy, but I guess it’s not that good. right… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… , If you get me a good toy, the story will go faster.
(Ethel nods with a bright smile at %s’s reaction.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I'll be waiting here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel like something has happened to me... Hmm. Is there anything like a toy that a big dog can play with?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The dog I saw recently was Hellfire, who was inside Lysithea's gate... I'll go and see if there's anything nearby.)
(Ethel tilts her head when she sees the large black bone she received from %s.)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: It's an incredibly large and strong stick. Where did you get this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's a toy that a magical beast, or rather a very large dog, played with at a place I visited before. I picked it up because it seemed like it had been thrown away.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I think Mendelsmann would like this. Thank you. So I learned a few things from them.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: If %s, who is at the center of the rumor, makes a move right away, something uproar could happen.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: For example, there are people who do not view %s very favorably... .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: While %s was getting Mendelsmann toys, I got help from the kids I was taking care of at the daycare center. There were some interesting stories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, I didn't even think they did this on purpose...)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: What are you thinking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. Thank you, Ethel.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Oops, there was something I was going to ask %s... . Professor Theodore, do you know? He's my teacher, and he often talks about %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course, I know Professor Theo well. I got a lot of help. By the way, what were you saying?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Even after the professor leaves for Esnil, send him a letter to give him something to study.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Recently, %s participated in the Battle of Moros and gave us a lot of information related to Freios and Eastland. This time it's about 60 pages... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, I see.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Are you going to listen to the kids now? Whose story do you think would be interesting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... which story do you hear first?)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: A likes to play with his younger siblings, so he takes them everywhere.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Glaston is huge. But there is no place I haven’t been to. They run around not only the square but also the administrative district.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I was just running down the streets of Lashuette when I came across an alley with a really strange atmosphere, and my older brother, who had animal ears like a prisoner, was lying down wearing only his pants.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: It looked like it was about to die, so I gave it some bread that I had saved to eat later, and something like a golem came from behind and said hello.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He then asked where there was a lot of clothes and said he flew away on a golem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This story seems like Noname... If this is true, it was somewhere in Rashuet...)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: B is a child whose hobby is to go out into the yard alone and stare blankly at the sky.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: When he came out again during his nap time and seemed dazed, I asked him why… .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I saw a flying dolphin.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dolphin?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: This isn't even the ocean, so how can I see dolphins... .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: The pink dolphin said hello and flew over to La Chuette Street.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I looked to see if other kids had seen it too, but no one knew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is a flying pink dolphin?)

choices.text: 3. Ethel’s friend Miss C (13 years old)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: My best friend C has been a bit strange since he was young. Of course, I'm still young and strange.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: My late grandmother was a well-known fortune teller in Glaston, and just like her, I am good at reading tarot. They say inspiration is great... .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Not long ago, while I was reading people's fortunes in the square, the surroundings suddenly became dark.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I was looking around, wondering what it was, and suddenly I felt like there was something above my head, so I looked up... .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: It was Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's Glaston, but it's called Glaston above again?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: It's not accurate because I haven't seen it. C said it felt like there was another world above the sky.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I was so shocked that I ran around, and there I saw a monster twice as tall as a person.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I asked the kid who was so scared that he couldn't move if the monster was the one who woke me up, and C said absolutely no.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: So the monster approached me saying, “Go away,” and I closed my eyes because I was scared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what happened?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He said he heard the sound of running water and opened his eyes to find himself in the plaza where he was reading tarot readings. I don't know how much of it is real.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: The people in front of him didn't know why he was scared, so they called his parents.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: C's parents said that they saw their grandmother do that a lot, so they thought C was like that too.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: So C is resting at home now. When I see a healthy child sitting at home, I think of my old self and feel sorry for him.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm, what on earth did that kid see?)

choices.text: 4. Mr. D (13 years old) who wants to learn black magic

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: D may be a teenager these days, but he is immersed in his own world.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: If you speak to me, mortal, you are alive and well even with an insignificant soul. What do you want from me? I'm talking about it this way.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Then, when the kids say something sarcastic, I say sorry because I have a weak heart. It's only for a moment, and so on.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: They were talking about Megiddo, Pandemonium, and Black Dragon, but I couldn't understand it at all, so I asked Professor Theodore and he explained it to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I understand Pandemonium, but what was Megido…?)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: They say Pandemonium is a big city in the demon world like Glaston... .

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: He said that Megido may have existed in ancient times so much that even today's demons are not aware of it.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Anyway, the words Mr. D uses are bad words, so I told him to stop using those words, so I scolded him just now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. D said where did he hear that story?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: One day, the kids went on a field trip to a magic building and got lost. After hearing the story of the wizards who found the way, they thought it was cool and followed along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What are the wizards doing that made them say that?...)

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Thank you for listening to the story. Actually, I didn't think people would listen to it because it was a story about young children... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I am more grateful. It was very helpful.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: I think I should go home now. I will put the flowers that Uncle Adrian gave me in a pretty bottle and deliver the toys to Mendelsmann.

lines.speaker: 에델
lines.text: See you later, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, Ethel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hmm... I think the stories Ethel told me need some organizing.)
